label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Code Agent SDK Features: SDK agents access same filesystem-based features as CLI: project instructions (CLAUDE.md, rules), skills, hooks, etc. settingSources parameter controls config layers: 'user', 'project', 'local', 'plugins', 'team', 'enterprise'. Omit settingSources to read same filesystem settings as CLI. Pass settingSources: [] to limit to programmatic config only. Python example shows setting_sources mapping: user (~/.claude/), project (<cwd>/.claude/), local (<cwd> and parents for CLAUDE.md/rules, <cwd> and parents up to repo root for skills/commands/subagents). Skills, commands, subagents from flag-added directories load through project setting source.
